templates.title: AbuseBox
templates.name: abusebox
templates.description: Self-hosted monitoring for the IPs and domains you run: 24 DNS blacklists, SSL and domain expiry, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and uptime, with an alert when something changes.
templates.note: Open AbuseBox at http://<your-server>:3000 . The admin password is generated on the first start and printed in the backend container's log. Set 'Allowed browser origins' to the exact address you open AbuseBox at, or the browser will block the API calls.

env.name: APP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.label: Allowed browser origins
env.description: The address you open AbuseBox at, comma separated for more than one. Example: http://192.168.1.10:3000

env.name: WEB_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port for the web interface.

env.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Admin email
env.description: Alerts for an asset go to the email of the user who owns it.

env.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password
env.description: Leave empty to have one generated on the first start and printed in the backend log.

env.name: SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MINUTES
env.label: Check interval (minutes)
env.description: How often monitored assets are re-checked. Can also be changed in Settings.
